text:
ahmed_procure: quick heads-up — vendor sent revised ETA for the H200/H100 bulk order. they want to split shipment across two AWBs and handle RMA replacements out of the second shipment. need confirmation on liability/insurance and whether we accept split manifests. anyone blocked by split arrival?
lia_vendor: we can commit to split: 40% initial air (AWB A1), 60% follow-up (AWB B2) 7–10 days later. replacements for DOA units will be staged in AWB B2 as discussed. carrier insurance covers loss/damage up to declared value, deductible USD 2k per AWB. we can attach a consolidated invoice and per-serial manifest. :truck:
ahmed_procure: deductible 2k per AWB is kinda high — what happens if there's partial damage in AWB A1 and replacements are in B2? do we need to open separate claims per AWB?
lia_vendor: yes separate claims by AWB. vendor side will initiate claim for damage on arrival A1. replacement flow: if DOA on A1, we'll hold replacement stock for you on AWB B2 and ship out with B2. if you need an expedite replacement earlier we can loan from local depot (subject to stock).
maria_ops: on our side, provisioning ops needs the per-serial CSV so we can map receipts -> allocations. also clarify HS code for customs for the follow-up: we've had delays before when HS didn't match.
kevin_sre: double-asking from infra: can we get a manifest with model, serial, S/N, and sku tag and preferred install region? also need the ETA window per AWB for autoscaler planning. If B2 is 7–10 days later we should reserve capacity in staging pool to avoid double-provisioning.
lia_vendor: will provide manifest by EOD local time. sample header we'll send:
```
sku,model,serial,sn,hw_rev,declared_value,awb,shipment_part
H200,H200-80GB,SN12345,SN12345,revA,65000,AWB A1,part1
```
lia_vendor: HS code for both AWBs confirmed as 8471.80.9000 — vendor to include on commercial invoice.
ahmed_procure: noted. who owns insurance claim admin? vendor or us? we need SLA on claim acknowlegement and TAT.
lia_vendor: vendor opens claim and coordinates with carrier. we guarantee initial acknowledgement within 48h of claim filing and a target resolution of 10 business days for straightforward damage cases. for hardware DOA replacement timeline — replacements will be shipped with B2 unless expedited.
kevin_sre: to avoid downtime we'll reserve 12 preemptible placeholders in staging for the H200 batch and tag as "incoming-h200-2468". maria_ops can you confirm reservation?
maria_ops: confirming reserve 12 units in staging pool for the H200 arrival window. will flag autoscaler rules to avoid using them for other jobs.
rma-bot: Automated RMA ticket created: RMA-2026-1123 — assigned to lia_vendor + infra-support. link: https://rma.internal/RMA-2026-1123
ahmed_procure: lia, can you also include warranty start date on manifest (we need to verify warranty starts on delivery date, not shipment date).
lia_vendor: yes will include warranty_start_date and delivery_awb_received_date fields in CSV. will send by EOD and cc: procurement@redwood.
maria_ops: action items: 1) vendor -> send manifest with warranty_start_date + HS codes (lia) 2) procurement -> review deductible & decide if we request depot loan (ahmed) 3) infra -> reserve staging pool & provide install mapping (kevin + maria). can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when they have the item?
kevin_sre: :white_check_mark: reserved 12.
lia_vendor: :white_check_mark: manifest incoming.
ahmed_procure: :thumbsup: I'll review deductible and follow up by EOD.
maria_ops: :white_check_mark: prepping import docs and IANA slot in case customs queries.
kevin_sre: one more note — please include serials in shipment-level packing list (carrier will need for customs clearance). otherwise we risk depot hold.
lia_vendor: understood, we'll attach serialized packing list and consolidated invoice. thanks everyone.
ahmed_procure: thanks — closing for now, we'll reopen if manifests show mismatches.
